env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd repro

# Ordinary commands never compile dependency tests, so the module is
# healthy for them: testonly is required only so the module graph loads
# offline, and nothing reachable imports it.
logos build ./...
logos test ./...

# d is a regular dependency, not an inactive-file owner, but
# collectTestBuilds still builds its test variant. Its test-only import
# (example.com/deptestonly/t) is reached by neither the variant roots
# nor their loaded imports, so it stays out of the loader's package
# set; before the fix eject failed resolving it.
logos eject -o out
exists out/p/p.go
exists out/p/p_test.go
exists out/p/engines_test.go
grep '^//go:build engines' out/p/engines_test.go

# The export must stand alone: drop the source nested module before
# running the exported tests, so a replace that still points at the
# checkout fails instead of passing.
rm testonly

cd out
go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
# The exported tests run too, including the dependency test that
# imports the newly resolved test-only package.
go test ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go test ./...
cd _logos_deps/example.com/deptestdep@v0.0.0
go test ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go test ./...
-- repro/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectdeptest

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/deptestdep v0.0.0
	example.com/deptestonly v0.0.0
)

replace (
	example.com/deptestdep => ./dep
	example.com/deptestonly => ./testonly
)

-- repro/p/p.lgo --
package p

import "example.com/deptestdep/d"

const Value = 1

func Name() string {
	return d.Name()
}

-- repro/p/p_test.lgo --
package p_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/deptestdep/d"
	"example.com/ejectdeptest/p"
)

func TestValue(t *testing.T) {
	if got := p.Value; got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("Value = %d, want 1", got)
	}
	if p.Name() != d.Name() {
		t.Fatalf("Name() = %q, want %q", p.Name(), d.Name())
	}
}

-- repro/p/engines_test.lgo --
//go:build engines

package p_test

-- repro/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/deptestdep

go 1.27

require example.com/deptestonly v0.0.0

replace example.com/deptestonly => ../testonly
-- repro/dep/d/d.go --
// Package d is a regular dependency of the variant root p: its
// non-test code imports logos/sync so the eject plan keeps this module,
// while only its external test file imports the test-only module.
package d

import "logos/sync"

const Input = "ABC"

// Name returns Input through a locked value.
func Name() string {
	var locked sync.Locked[string]
	locked.WithLock(func(value *string) {
		*value = Input
	})
	var got string
	locked.WithLock(func(value *string) {
		got = *value
	})
	return got
}

-- repro/dep/d/d_test.go --
package d_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/deptestdep/d"
	"example.com/deptestonly/t"
)

func TestName(tt *testing.T) {
	if got := d.Name(); got != t.Greet() {
		tt.Fatalf("Name() = %q, want %q", got, t.Greet())
	}
}

-- repro/testonly/go.mod --
module example.com/deptestonly

go 1.27

-- repro/testonly/t/t.go --
// Package t is imported only by d's external test file; no non-test
// code in the module graph reaches it.
package t

// Greet reports the string d.Name returns.
func Greet() string {
	return "ABC"
}
